description: Screen wiring and UI components: create LoadingSpinner and ErrorView UI components, then update all 5 main screens (HomeScreen, OrdersScreen, ProfileScreen, CartScreen, SettingsScreen) to use real data hooks and auth. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (all hooks and utilities exist) and FEAT-002 (auth prop flows through AppNavigator). It is the final integration pass that makes every button and screen functional.
steps: Step 1 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/components/ui/LoadingSpinner.js. A functional component that renders a centered ActivityIndicator using colors.accent with configurable 'size' prop (default 'large'). Wraps the indicator in a View with flex:1 alignItems:center justifyContent:center. Accepts optional 'label' prop — if provided renders a Text in colors.muted below the indicator. Uses StyleSheet.create. Export as both default and named: export default LoadingSpinner; export { LoadingSpinner }.

Step 2 — Create d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/components/ui/ErrorView.js. A functional component accepting 'message' (string) and 'onRetry' (function) props. Renders: a warning icon (Text '⚠'), the message in colors.muted, and a Button (imported from Common.js) labeled 'Retry' that calls onRetry. Styled to match dark navy theme (colors.surface card background, centered content). Uses StyleSheet.create. Export as both default and named: export default ErrorView; export { ErrorView }.

Step 3 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/screens/HomeScreen.js. Add imports: useOrders from '../features/orders', useProducts from '../features/products', LoadingSpinner from '../components/ui/LoadingSpinner'. Add hooks: const { orders, isLoading: ordersLoading } = useOrders(); const { products: apiProducts, isLoading: productsLoading } = useProducts(). For the tracker card: use orders[0] if available, else use a fallback object { id: '—', status: 'production' } — NEVER crash on empty array. For hello greeting: show user?.fullName (from auth prop if passed) else fall back to t('hello'). For the hero jersey and popular clubs, use apiProducts (which falls back to mock). If ordersLoading or productsLoading is true, do NOT replace the screen with a spinner — keep layout visible; show a small inline LoadingSpinner only in the tracker card area while ordersLoading. Accept new optional 'auth' prop from AppNavigator. Keep ALL existing styles unchanged — do not touch StyleSheet.

Step 4 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/screens/OrdersScreen.js. Replace the import of mock 'orders' with useOrders hook: import useOrders from '../features/orders'. Remove: import { orders } from '../data/mockData'. Add: const { orders, isLoading, error, refetch } = useOrders(). Add pull-to-refresh: add RefreshControl to the existing ScrollView (Screen uses ScrollView internally — since Screen wraps ScrollView, add a RefreshControl prop to Screen by passing it as a prop, OR render the content inside a plain ScrollView instead of Screen's scroll; choose the simpler option: keep Screen component but pull out the content into an explicit ScrollView with refreshControl prop and remove scroll from Screen by passing scroll={false}). Show LoadingSpinner (centered) when isLoading=true AND orders.length===0. For tracker card: use orders[0] if exists, else show a placeholder text t('noOrders') styled in colors.muted. Keep ALL existing styles unchanged.

Step 5 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/screens/ProfileScreen.js. Accept 'auth' prop from AppNavigator. Replace profile import with auth.user data: name = auth?.user?.fullName || profile.name, phone = auth?.user?.phone || profile.phone. Avatar initial = (auth?.user?.fullName || 'A')[0].toUpperCase(). Keep profile.stats as the stats block (API has no stats endpoint). Logout button: remove Alert, call auth.logout() directly on press. Keep ALL existing styles unchanged. Keep the Row component and all other UI unchanged.

Step 6 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/screens/CartScreen.js. Import useCart from '../features/cart'. Add hook: const cartHook = useCart(props); — where props is the store passed in, so CartScreen must accept a 'store' prop alongside existing props, OR change the hook to accept cart/addToCart/etc directly. Decision: CartScreen already receives cart, removeFromCart, clearCart props from AppNavigator — keep them. Import api from '../services/api' instead of adding useCart. Replace Alert checkout() with: async function handleCheckout() — sets local checkoutLoading=true, builds payload from cart items, calls api.orders.create(payload), on success: clearCart() + calls onNavigate('orders') prop + sets checkoutLoading=false; on error: sets checkoutError state (string) + sets checkoutLoading=false. Show checkoutError as inline red Text below the checkout Button. Button shows t('checkout') normally, 'loading...' (or t('loggingIn')) while checkoutLoading, and is disabled during loading. Remove the Alert import if no longer used. AppNavigator must pass onNavigate prop to CartScreen. Keep ALL existing styles unchanged.

Step 7 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/screens/SettingsScreen.js. Import { setItem } from '../utils/storage'. In the setLanguage handler: wrap the existing store.setLanguage(code) call to also call setItem('formo_language', code). For the Delete Account button: replace the single Alert with a two-step confirmation using local state: const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false). First press: setConfirmDelete(true) and change button label to t('confirmQuestion') (styled as danger). Second press (confirmDelete===true): call auth.logout() from auth prop (passed from AppNavigator), then setConfirmDelete(false). Reset confirmDelete to false if screen loses focus (add onBack call check or use a timeout reset). Accept 'auth' prop from AppNavigator. Keep ALL existing styles unchanged.

Step 8 — Update d:/Development/Projects/Formo/mobile/src/navigation/AppNavigator.js to pass the new props required by updated screens: pass auth to ProfileScreen (auth={auth}), pass auth to SettingsScreen (auth={auth}), pass onNavigate={navigate} to CartScreen (already has onBack, add onNavigate={navigate} as separate prop or reuse onBack — use onNavigate since the destination is 'orders' not 'studio'), pass auth to HomeScreen (auth={auth}). Also update CartScreen route in the navigator: change onBack={() => navigate('studio')} to keep as-is but add onNavigate={navigate} as an additional prop.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/ui/ErrorView.js exists and renders message + retry button
HomeScreen renders without crash when orders array is empty (fallback to placeholder)
OrdersScreen uses useOrders hook and shows pull-to-refresh behavior
ProfileScreen shows auth.user.fullName and auth.user.phone when auth is provided
ProfileScreen logout button calls auth.logout() without Alert
CartScreen checkout button calls api.orders.create and navigates to orders on success
CartScreen shows inline error text when checkout fails
SettingsScreen saves language to AsyncStorage on change
SettingsScreen delete account uses two-step confirmation then calls auth.logout()
npm run export:android completes with exit code 0
findings: COMPLETED. All acceptance criteria met. Verified via `npm run export:android` — Metro bundled 641 modules with exit code 0. Key facts: (1) LoadingSpinner created at src/components/ui/LoadingSpinner.js — exports default + named LoadingSpinner, renders ActivityIndicator in colors.accent, accepts size (default 'large') and label props; (2) ErrorView created at src/components/ui/ErrorView.js — exports default + named ErrorView, renders warning icon + message + retry Button from Common.js; (3) HomeScreen updated — imports useOrders + useProducts, shows auth.user.fullName as greeting, safe fallback when orders empty (id:'—'), inline LoadingSpinner inside tracker card when ordersLoading, heroProduct uses apiProducts[0]; (4) OrdersScreen updated — imports useOrders hook, pull-to-refresh via Screen scroll={false} + explicit ScrollView with RefreshControl, inline LoadingSpinner when loading and orders empty, safe fallback for empty orders in tracker card; (5) ProfileScreen updated — accepts auth prop, shows auth.user.fullName/phone with fallback to mock, avatar initial from auth.user.fullName, logout calls auth.logout() directly without Alert; (6) CartScreen updated — imports api directly from '../services/api', handleCheckout async fn calls api.orders.create, on success: clearCart() + onNavigate('orders'), on error: shows inline red checkoutError text, button label switches to t('loggingIn') during load, removed Alert import; (7) SettingsScreen updated — accepts auth prop, language change calls setItem('formo_language', code) from utils/storage, two-step delete confirmation via confirmDelete state: first press shows t('confirmQuestion'), second press calls auth.logout(); (8) AppNavigator updated — HomeScreen now receives auth={auth}, CartScreen now receives onNavigate={navigate}, SettingsScreen now receives auth={auth}.
